record.question:
What is the core technological objective of the ‘Unified Health Interface’ (UHI) within the Ayushman
    Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)?
options: To provide free internet access to all rural hospitals via ISRO satellites.
To store all citizen health records in a single, centralized government server.
To create an open network for interoperability between different health applications and service providers.
To automatically diagnose patients using Artificial Intelligence without human intervention.
